title: TUI edit pane: description editor slot clamped to pane rows (~3-4 lines) regardless of terminal height
description: In edit_pane_geometry (src/tui.rs), the armed Description widget slot height is `editor_height.min(available)` where `available` = the pane's OTHER rows + hint (~3-4). So a multi-line description gets a ~3-4 line editing window even in a large terminal. render_edit_pane already clamps the slot to the actual detail area height - the geometry clamp is wrong and should be removed. Fix: drop the 'available' clamp; slot grows with content, clamped by the area in render. Regression test: 6-line description must render all 6 lines (fails pre-fix). Reported by user 2026-09-24.
